page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number at top right. Above the text, two verse lines continue the previous poem. Then a centred heading, a verse poem with a large initial P, a second centred heading in capitals with a sub-title and date, and a further verse poem with a large initial N, ending with a signature mark at the right.

main_text.head: AD THEODORVM BEZAM.

p.i: Ad te carmina misi nec Latino
Nec Graio sale tincta sed Britannis
Nata in montibus horrida sub Arcto,
Ut classis modo in ultima referri

main_text.head: ADAMAS IN CORDIS EFFIGIEM sculptus, annulóque insertus, quem Maria Scotorum Regina ad Elizabetham Anglorum Reginam misit, anno CIↃ.D.LXIIII.

p.i: Non lux perspicui, nec ars magistri,
Qui formam dedit hanc, datam loquaci
Sed quòd cor Domina mea figura
Tam certa exprimo, pectore ut reclusò

page.notes: Right margin catchword or signature "H.iij" is printed at the foot right. Some marginal ornaments and show-through are omitted. The heading line "ADAMAS IN CORDIS EFFIGIEM" is set in spaced capitals; the date is printed as CIↃ.D.LXIIII, rendered as MDLXIIII in the printed form as shown. The first word of the first poem is partly damaged and read as "Pasful" (possibly "Rasful") [?].
